CustomField.formula: IF( Meses_Transcurridos_flexibles__c = 0, "Pagada", IF( OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(Forma_pago__c,"Mensual"), Meses_Transcurridos_flexibles__c = 1), AND(ISPICKVAL(Forma_pago__c,"Trimestral"), Meses_Transcurridos_flexibles__c = 3), AND(ISPICKVAL(Forma_pago__c,"Semestral"), Meses_Transcurridos_flexibles__c = 6), AND(ISPICKVAL(Forma_pago__c,"Anual"), Meses_Transcurridos_flexibles__c = 12) ), "Pendiente", "Sin coincidencia" ) )
